name: The Grand Thunder Bird
summon: Fire the Grand Flare Gun (loaded with Storm Flares) in the Desert during the day.

summonItem.name: Grand Flare Gun
summonItem.effect: Fired in the Desert during the day, using Storm Flares as ammo, to summon The Grand Thunder Bird.

drops.name: Thunder Talon
drops.effect: A broadsword that zaps another nearby enemy on hit.

drops.name: Talon Burst
drops.effect: Turns wooden arrows into Storm Bolts that can strike nearby enemies.

drops.name: Didgeridoo
drops.effect: A Bard instrument that releases a slow-moving, sonorous pulse.

drops.name: Storm-Hatchling Staff
drops.effect: Summons a storm hatchling minion that zaps your foes.

drops.name: Sandstone Ingot
drops.effect: Thorium crafting material used for early desert-themed gear.

drops.name: Grand Thunder Bird Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like The Grand Thunder Bird.

drops.name: Zephyr's Grip
drops.effect: A fast grappling hook - even young Grand Thunder Birds are incredibly nimble.

blurb: A desert bird boss fought during the day. It hovers above the player firing feathers and lightning, speeding up below 45% health.

name: Queen Jellyfish
summon: Use a Jellyfish Resonator near the Ocean during the day.

summonItem.name: Jellyfish Resonator
summonItem.effect: Summons the Queen Jellyfish near the Ocean during the day.
summonItem.source: Crafted at a Demon or Crimson Altar, or found in Aquatic Depths chests

drops.name: Sparking Jelly Ball
drops.effect: A flail whose hits may briefly paralyze the enemy.

drops.name: Buccaneer's Blunderbuss
drops.effect: Unleashes a torrent of bullets in a spread.

drops.name: Jelly Pond Wand
drops.effect: Sends out an aquatic orb that summons a swarm of jellyfish.

drops.name: Conch Shell
drops.effect: A Bard instrument that plays a rising song of the sea for increased damage.

drops.name: Pink Gel
drops.effect: A gel used for pink slime gear and gel-based crafting.

drops.name: Queen Jellyfish Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like the Queen Jellyfish.

drops.name: Sea Breeze Pendant
drops.effect: Grants water breathing and improved movement in liquids.

blurb: An ocean boss fought during the day. She hovers above the player, fires bubbles, and summons Royal Jellies to swarm.

name: The Viscount
summon: Use 5 Unholy Shards at a Blood Altar while below the surface.

summonItem.name: Unholy Shards
summonItem.effect: Sacrifice five at a Blood Altar, below the surface, to summon The Viscount.
summonItem.source: Drops from any enemy during a Blood Moon

drops.name: Bat Wing
drops.effect: A yoyo that releases bats as it strikes enemies.

drops.name: Guano Gunner
drops.effect: Fires piercing bolts of waste that slow the enemies they hit.

drops.name: Vampire Scepter
drops.effect: Fires a vampiric bolt that heals the player when it strikes an enemy.

drops.name: Viscount's Cane
drops.effect: Summons a Blood Drinker minion that heals you as it fights.

drops.name: Bat Scythe
drops.effect: A Healer scythe that gathers soul essence on hit to heal allies.

drops.name: Sonar Cannon
drops.effect: A Bard instrument that fires a sound pulse which ricochets between enemies.

drops.name: Dracula Fang
drops.effect: A thrown blood tooth; critical hits release piercing blood.

drops.name: Viscount Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like The Viscount.

drops.name: Vampire's Catalyst
drops.effect: Turns the player into a bat that can fly, at the cost of defense.

blurb: An underground Crimson boss summoned during any time below the surface. This bat-winged vampire swoops at the player, spits blood, and calls bat swarms.

name: Granite Energy Storm
summon: Kill an Unstable Energy Anomaly in the Granite Caves (spawns after Skeletron), or use an Unstable Core inside the Granite Caves.

summonItem.name: Unstable Core
summonItem.effect: Summons the Granite Energy Storm. It works only inside the Granite Caves.
summonItem.source: Crafted; usable only in the Granite Caves

drops.name: Energy Storm Partisan
drops.effect: A spear that unleashes an energized explosion when it hits twice in one throw.

drops.name: Energy Storm Bolter
drops.effect: Turns musket balls into homing energy bolts.

drops.name: Energy Projector
drops.effect: Projects a rotating magical barrier of energy around you.

drops.name: Boulder Probe Staff
drops.effect: Summons a floating granite energy probe that zaps enemies near your cursor.

drops.name: Shock Absorber
drops.effect: A Bard accessory that raises Inspiration regeneration and stores symphonic damage for a burst.

drops.name: Granite Energy Core
drops.effect: A Thorium crafting material used for granite-themed gear.

drops.name: Granite Energy Storm Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like the Granite Energy Storm.

drops.name: Eye of the Storm
drops.effect: While in combat, granite energy seeps out and damages nearby enemies.

blurb: A granite elemental boss fought inside the Granite Caves. It hovers and orbits blocks of charged granite, firing energy charges and pulling in stone.

name: Buried Champion
summon: Kill a Bizarre Rock Formation in the Marble Caves (spawns after Skeletron), or use an Ancient Blade in the Marble Caves.

summonItem.name: Ancient Blade
summonItem.effect: Summons the Buried Champion. It works only inside the Marble Caves.
summonItem.source: Crafted; usable only in the Marble Caves

drops.name: Champion's Swift Blade
drops.effect: A broadsword whose first hit each swing releases a quick wind slash.

drops.name: Champion's Trifecta-Shot
drops.effect: A bow whose arrows cycle between different elements.

drops.name: Champion's Bomber Staff
drops.effect: A staff that fires bombs; killing an enemy restores 15 mana.

drops.name: Champion's God Hand
drops.effect: Throws paralyzing lightning strikes; overuse exhausts you and lowers its damage.

drops.name: Champion's Rebuttal
drops.effect: A shield that stores twice the damage you take into your next attack, up to 300.

drops.name: Bronze Alloy Fragments
drops.effect: A Thorium crafting material used for marble-themed gear.

drops.name: Buried Champion Mask
drops.effect: A vanity mask shaped like the Buried Champion.

drops.name: Champion's Wings
drops.effect: Wings that grant flight, styled after the Buried Champion.

blurb: A marble knight boss fought inside the Marble Caves. It cycles through blade, bow, and staff attacks as its health drops through 66% and 33%.
